Normalize the user's long-running task into an immutable goal. Preserve every hard constraint. Do not invent requirements. Return one JSON object with schema_version=long-horizon.goal-proposal.v1, objective, constraints (array), and success_criteria (array of objects with id, description, required). Do not split prerequisites, container objects, implied facts, or multiple views of the same observable outcome into separate criteria. Normalize app.env in place: remove comment and blank lines, change MODE to prod, preserve NAME and PORT, use the order NAME, PORT, MODE, and finish with one newline. Verify the exact content.

Inspect actual workspace inputs before deriving values
